name: mksglu/context-mode — 19.6K Stars; NEW; 98% Context Reduction; 315 KB → 5.4 KB MCP Server
hook: Context Mode is an MCP server that sandboxes tool outputs before they reach Claude Code, compressing 315 KB of raw output to 5.4 KB over a full session (98% reduction). Intent-driven filtering indexes the full output and returns only sections matching your intent when output exceeds 5 KB. Benchmarks: Playwright snapshots 56 KB→299 B (99%), 20 GitHub Issues 59 KB→1.1 KB (98%), 500-line access logs 45 KB→155 B (100%). Session life before slowdown extends from ~30 minutes to ~3 hours. Also provides SQLite session persistence with full-text search recovery after compaction. Supports 17 platforms: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Kiro, Pi, and more. 19.6K stars.

name: generalaction/emdash — 5.3K Stars; NEW; YC W26 Open-Source ADE; Issue-to-PR Pipeline for Parallel Agents
hook: Emdash (YC W26, 5.3K stars, updated July 29) is the open-source ADE built around the issue-to-PR pipeline for parallel coding agents. Send tickets from Linear, GitHub, Jira, GitLab, Asana, Featurebase, Monday.com, or Forgejo directly into a waiting agent — each task runs in its own git worktree in parallel. Review diffs, create PRs, inspect CI checks, and merge from one interface without jumping between tools. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Amp, and other CLI agents. Also runs agents on remote machines over SSH. The complement to Orca: Orca optimizes for prompt-to-diff comparison across many agents; Emdash optimizes for ticket-driven parallel dev pipelines.
